900100.body:
The morning commute, interplanetary: the Venus shuttle.

The Earth–Venus shuttle run is the interplanetary commute: the regular transfer between the worlds, timed to the synodic rhythm. The route's windows open every 584 days, and the shuttle rides the Hohmann arc. The leg is the 146-day cruise, the aerobraking arrival, the cloud-city rendezvous. The route's lesson is the patience: the inner system runs on the synodic clock. The shuttle runs; the clock rules.
900100.title: The Earth–Venus Shuttle Run
900100.description: The morning commute, interplanetary: the Venus shuttle.

900101.body:
The moon as a port: the Phobos ferry.

The Mars–Phobos ferry treats the moon as a port: the tiny moon's stickney harbor, the elevator's anchor, the staging point for the surface. The route's legs are the climb from Mars, the rendezvous at Phobos, the descent by tether. The ferry's lesson is the moon's gift: Phobos is the low-gravity harbor Mars never had. The ferry docks; the moon serves.
900101.title: The Mars–Phobos Ferry
900101.description: The moon as a port: the Phobos ferry.

900102.body:
The belt's warehouse: the Ceres run.

The Ceres supply line feeds the belt: the dwarf planet's harbors, the ice mines, the foundries — the belt's warehouse district. The route's legs are the Earth–Ceres cruise, the low-gravity docking, the cargo exchange. The line's lesson is the logistics: the belt runs on Ceres the way the coasts run on ports. The supply line delivers; the belt builds.
900102.title: The Ceres Supply Line
900102.description: The belt's warehouse: the Ceres run.

900103.body:
Water for the outer system: the Europa run.

The Europa ice run hauls water for the outer system: the moon's ocean, the surface mines, the tankers bound for the stations. The route's legs are the Jupiter approach, the radiation-dodging transfer, the ice loading. The run's lesson is the resource: water is the outer system's oil. The tankers haul; the stations drink.
900103.title: The Europa Ice Run
900103.description: Water for the outer system: the Europa run.

900104.body:
The edge of the classical: the Neptune corridor.

The Neptune flyby corridor serves the edge of the classical system: the gravity assists, the Triton stop, the Kuiper staging. The route's legs are the long cruise, the Neptune bend, the outward fling. The corridor's lesson is the leverage: the giant's gravity is the free fuel. The corridor bends; the trajectory flies.
900104.title: The Neptune Flyby Corridor
900104.description: The edge of the classical: the Neptune corridor.

900105.body:
The frontier circuit: the Kuiper survey.

The Kuiper Belt survey route circuits the frontier: the dwarf planets, the cold classicals, the scattered disk — the survey's stations. The route's legs are the outward leg, the survey loops, the data return. The route's lesson is the patience: the frontier is vast, and the survey is slow. The surveyor circuits; the frontier yields.
900105.title: The Kuiper Belt Survey Route
900105.description: The frontier circuit: the Kuiper survey.

900106.body:
The upstream post: the L1 run.

The Sun–Earth L1 relay run serves the upstream post: the solar observatory, the storm warning station, the million-mile outpost. The route's legs are the climb sunward, the halo insertion, the station keeping. The run's lesson is the vigilance: the L1 post watches the sun for the Earth. The relay runs; the warning precedes.
900106.title: The Sun–Earth L1 Relay Run
900106.description: The upstream post: the L1 run.

900107.body:
The safe harbor: the Callisto depot.

The Callisto fuel depot run serves the safe harbor: the moon outside Jupiter's harsh belts, the depot's tanks, the outer system's gas station. The route's legs are the Jupiter system entry, the Callisto rendezvous, the fueling. The run's lesson is the refuge: Callisto is the harbor the radiation can't reach. The depot fuels; the system moves.
900107.title: The Callisto Fuel Depot Run
900107.description: The safe harbor: the Callisto depot.

900108.body:
The sideways giant's gift: the Uranus lane.

The Uranus slingshot lane takes the sideways giant's gift: the gravity assist that bends trajectories toward the outer dark. The route's legs are the approach, the slingshot bend, the outward cruise. The lane's lesson is the tilt: the sideways system offers the sideways assist. The lane bends; the dark approaches.
900108.title: The Uranus Slingshot Lane
900108.description: The sideways giant's gift: the Uranus lane.

900109.body:
The capstone: the departure lounge for the stars.

The interstellar staging orbit is the capstone: the departure lounge for the stars — the high orbit where the precursor missions assemble. The route's legs are the climb from Earth, the staging rendezvous, the interstellar injection. The orbit's lesson is the threshold: the solar system ends, and the staging begins. Fifteen routes mapped; the sixteenth leaves the map. The atlas is complete; the journey continues.
900109.title: The Interstellar Staging Orbit
900109.description: The capstone: the departure lounge for the stars.
